people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

translations.web: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
translations.bsb: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
translations.kjv: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
translations.asv: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A high mountain is the mountain of Bashan.
